notesI18n.zh: 新增宠物狗·泰迪主题：代码绘制红棕卷毛泰迪，支持拖动、点击和抚摸，自主走动、小跑、嗅闻、睡觉和躲藏；四脚步态与睡眠呼吸动画，保留隐藏的图片版用于对比。
notesI18n.en: New Teddy Puppy theme: a code-drawn red-brown poodle with dragging, clicking and petting, autonomous walking, trotting, sniffing, sleeping and hiding, coordinated four-leg gait and breathing animation. The image renderer is retained for comparison.
